title: Place a pad that follows the cursor
summary: Creates a bottom test-point pad with PCBObjectFactory and moves it with the board cursor from Win32 mouse and keyboard hooks until a click keeps it or Escape removes it, without blocking Altium Designer; shows how to remove hooks safely on unload.
phrasings: drag a new object with the mouse before placing it
follow the cursor on a PCB board
use a mouse hook in an Altium extension
dim the board while placing an object
